name: Vivian
source: A ParaMail rider of the First Unit who has extraordinarily good combat abilities. Vivian is a naturally cheerful and airheaded girl whose hobby is suddenly making up quizzes and then asking her friends about them. Unlike the rest of the unit, she's also very friendly toward everybody. She is always shown eating lollipops.
